text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Gold City's Make Debut. 
Reporters gathered to watch her future 
moves closely,
with some hoping to see her 
pursue the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City declared to them, "Watch me 
run." However, the only thing that drew 
their attention was still her looks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was growing impatient because people 
only praised her looks.
Feeling pressured, 
she believed she had to produce results
in 
races to prove she was more than just a 
pretty face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Just run your own way." With those 
parting words from her Trainer,
she headed out. "Of course," she replied,
stepping up 
to her debut race.
